name: 小芒
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=小芒
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = mgesq.api.mgtv.com, *.hitv.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/mgesq\.api\.mgtv\.com\/v2\/goods\/guess_you_like/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /https:\/\/mgesq.api.mgtv.com\/v2\/user\/center\/icon/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/mgesq\.api\.mgtv\.com\/search\/goods\/rank/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/mgesq\.api\.mgtv\.com\/user\/center\/config/i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /https:\/\/mgesq.api.mgtv.com\/dsl\/index.+/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sliverkiss/QuantumultX/main/AdBlock/xmApp/xmApp.js") with enable=${xnmh_enable}, tag="小芒APP主页广告", timeout=60, requires_body=true
